errors.auth_public_urls_invalid: Not a valid public address. Use https://name[:port][/prefix].
errors.auth_host_guard_would_lock_out: Enforcing would reject the address you are using now ({{host}}). Add it as a public address first.

public.title: Public addresses
public.help: The addresses that reach Meshloom from outside, such as your reverse proxy or Tailscale name. They must use https.
public.rejectedHelp: Names used to reach Meshloom that are not declared. Since the last restart, most recent first.
public.enforceHelpOff: Observation mode: unknown names are listed above and still work. Declaring the first public address turns enforcement on.
public.enforceHelpOn: Enforced: only declared names are accepted. If a name stops working, open Meshloom by its IP address and turn this off.
public.rejectedRisk: Allow only a name you set up yourself: an unknown name may come from an attacker.
public.confirmTitle: Declare this name as a public address?
public.confirmRisk: Meshloom will answer to this name from now on. Continue only if it is yours.
